print_errors.note: A small waqf-like sign (looks like ۖ) is printed on top of the opening ornate bracket ﴿ itself, not on any word; treated as a stray ornament and not transcribed.
All three occurrences on p.087 print a single kasra, placed under the lam of the لهم ligature, and no kasra under the heh. Compare «أَدْيَانِهِمْ», where both kasras are printed. Kept as printed.
End of the first paragraph: the yeh has a shadda with no kasra. The second paragraph on p.087 and p.086 line 1 have «العَلِيِّ» with shadda+kasra. Kept as printed.
Kasratan is printed under both the yeh and the hamza. Kept as printed (tatweel after the sheen dropped).

notes: p.085 continues p.084 mid-Quran (الرحمن ٢٠): marker 085+ and the span is reopened with ﴿ (p.084 closes it after بَرْزَخٌ). p.088 continues p.087 mid-sentence: marker 088+. KASRA UNDER THE ALLAH LIGATURE: in the Lotus body font, a kasra on the ligature الله/لله is drawn unusually low, about a third of the way down to the next line. It is easy to mistake for a fatha on the line below. I measured every ligature on pp.085-088; this mark is always exactly the same distance below the ligature, and p.053 «بِاللهِ» shows the same placement. These are therefore written اللهِ: p.085 بِسْمِ اللهِ بَابُنَا، وَعَيْنُ اللهِ(١)، بِحَوْلِ اللهِ؛ p.086 للهِ رَبِّ، اسمَ اللهِ الأعظم، عَطَاءِ اللهِ؛ p.087 بِسْمِ اللهِ، (×several), وَبِاللهِ … وَفِي اللهِ؛ p.088 بِسْمِ اللهِ خَيْرِ … بِسْمِ اللهِ أَفْتَتِحُ. Where no mark is printed, plain الله is written. A printed damma is written اللهُ (no added shadda). Also as printed: «إِلا» without shadda (p.087 ×2) and «إِلَّا» with shadda (p.086, p.088); «شَيءٌ» without sukun (p.085, p.088). The subtitle lines under the p.087 title are plain paragraphs per STRUCTURE §2 (the second one is printed bold). Reference «[الرحمن: ١٩-٢٠]» on p.085: the space after the colon is narrower than in the other references; I wrote a space.
